parser.overflow: suppress the over-depth subtree or overlength atom without prediction or learning until its causal delimiter closes

program_table.state: exact current template-name hash, previous completed field-key hash or positional marker, and zero-based field index
program_table.target: next named field-key bytes followed by transformed equals M
program_table.update: deterministic two-candidate Space-Saving heavy hitters after the target key has been fully decoded
program_table.selection: candidate lower-bound support at least two and strict majority of the state's completed observations
program_table.set_replacement: lowest observation count, then lowest source-ordered way

treatment: At a decoded field boundary, replay the selected next-key program until completion or the first treatment mismatch.

controls.K: identical parsing, lookup, state writes, counters, collisions, and hashes with prediction disabled
controls.R: splitmix64 bytes at the exact D opportunity positions
controls.S: program selected from the immediately preceding completed template name with the same prior-key and field-index coordinates; if absent, rotate D's target by one byte so activation and length remain matched

next_gate_on_pass: retained-parent donor-surprise trace over the exact D opportunity manifest
terminal_on_miss: retire this exact schema-program information source without parser, table, support, or state-key sweep
